{{Quote|Navy just deployed the next-generation prototype of our top orbital strike weapon. She's a real beauty, let me tell you.|Zahn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Delta-A5''' was a prototype orbital strike weapon developed by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Specialist [[Zahn]] tested the weapon against the [[Exchange]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
